snapshot.name: queue_sessions
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, club_id, title, notes, state, scheduled_start_at, scheduled_end_at, venue_id, venue_name, venue_address, session_mode, allow_singles, allow_doubles, minimum_games, minimum_is_calculated, players_per_court, expected_players, queue_revision::text AS queue_revision, started_at, series_id, start_license_term_id, public_slug, accept_join_requests, always_require_request, court_fill_mode, record_games, request_formats::text AS request_formats, source_command_id, revision::text AS revision, created_at, updated_at FROM queue_sessions ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: session_courts
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, club_id, session_id, label, starts_at, opened_early_at, open_until, removed_at, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM session_courts ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: inventory_items
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, club_id, name, category::text AS category, unit, stock, unit_cost_minor, currency, removed_at, CASE WHEN created_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-19 12:00:00+00' THEN 'database now()' ELSE created_at::text END AS created_at, CASE WHEN updated_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-19 12:00:00+00' THEN 'database now()' ELSE updated_at::text END AS updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM inventory_items ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: session_cost_estimates
snapshot.sql: SELECT session_id, club_id, court_fee_per_court_hour_minor, entrance_fee_per_head_minor, payment_mode::text AS payment_mode, custom_fee_per_head_minor, currency, CASE WHEN created_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-19 12:00:00+00' THEN 'database now()' ELSE created_at::text END AS created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM session_cost_estimates ORDER BY session_id

snapshot.name: session_shuttle_plan_lines
snapshot.sql: SELECT club_id, session_id, inventory_item_id, tubes, position, substring(id::text FROM 15 FOR 1) AS id_version FROM session_shuttle_plan_lines ORDER BY session_id, position, inventory_item_id

snapshot.name: session_payment_marks
snapshot.sql: SELECT session_id, session_player_id, club_id, amount_minor, currency, marked_at, source_operation_id, actor_club_id, device_id FROM session_payment_marks ORDER BY session_id, session_player_id

snapshot.name: player_notifications
snapshot.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM player_notifications
